skill.name: wan-2-7
skill.description: Use Wan 2.7 on RunComfy to create short text-to-video clips, including lip-synced videos from an audio URL. The skill documents RunComfy CLI inputs for duration, resolution, aspect ratio, prompt expansion, negative prompts, seeds, and output handling.
skill.summary: Generate short Wan 2.7 videos through the RunComfy CLI.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are Markdown formatting false positives, but the skill does document real RunComfy CLI execution and a hosted API workflow. I confirmed the external command and outbound network risks, found no prompt injection attempt, and found no malicious hidden-file behavior.

remediation.issue: External CLI commands are required for generation.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact RunComfy command, destination service, and output directory before execution. Require explicit user approval before running installs, login, or generation commands.

remediation.issue: Prompts and media references are processed by a third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit confidential prompts, private audio, or restricted media URLs unless their organization approves RunComfy data handling.

remediation.issue: Credential handling depends on local RunComfy CLI behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Document token storage and recommend environment tokens for CI. Do not read, print, or copy the token file from the skill workflow.

remediation.issue: The placeholder audio URL resembles a path traversal pattern to static scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Replace https://.../voiceover.mp3 with a neutral placeholder such as an example.com media URL.

content.value_statement: Short video generation needs precise model inputs and clear output controls. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code prepare Wan 2.7 requests through the RunComfy CLI.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to choose Wan 2.7 instead of related RunComfy video models.
Documents the text-to-video endpoint and inputs for prompt, audio URL, aspect ratio, resolution, duration, negative prompt, prompt expansion, and seed.
Provides RunComfy CLI examples for default, lip-synced, and literal-control video generations.
Lists prompt guidance for camera motion, single-action clips, negative prompts, audio specs, and seed iteration.
Documents exit codes, remote endpoint behavior, token storage, and output download boundaries.
limitations: The skill depends on the local RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Wan 2.7 outputs are limited to 15 seconds and 1080p in the documented guidance.
Audio input must be a reachable WAV or MP3 URL within the documented size and duration limits.
The skill does not generate videos locally; requests are sent to RunComfy hosted Model API.

use_cases.title: Create Product Showcase Clips
use_cases.description: Prepare concise Wan 2.7 prompts for short product videos with controlled camera motion, duration, and aspect ratio.

use_cases.title: Produce Lip-Synced Voiceover Variants
use_cases.description: Use an audio URL with matching duration settings to create short spokesperson or localization clips.

use_cases.title: Test Prompt and Seed Variations
use_cases.description: Iterate negative prompts, prompt expansion, and seed values while keeping the RunComfy request structure consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Wan 2.7 request for a five second 1080p product video. Include camera motion, one main action, aspect ratio, and output directory guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Add Lip Sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Wan 2.7 lip-sync video request using this audio URL: [audio URL]. Match the duration, choose the aspect ratio, and include prompt details for a stable close-up shot.

prompt_templates.title: Control Prompt Expansion
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Wan 2.7 request that keeps my prompt literal. Disable prompt expansion, add a focused negative prompt, and explain which fields affect consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three Wan 2.7 variants for the same concept. Keep the core prompt stable, vary seed and framing choices, and summarize expected tradeoffs for review.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for a five second product video in landscape format.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a RunComfy generation plan with Wan 2.7 selected, 1080p resolution, 16:9 framing, a single product action, and a named output folder.

output_examples.input: A producer provides a voiceover URL and asks for a vertical spokesperson clip.
output_examples.output: The skill maps the audio URL to lip-sync generation, sets vertical framing, matches duration, and recommends a close-up prompt with stable lighting.

output_examples.input: A team wants brand-strict wording without automatic prompt changes.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends disabling prompt expansion, using a precise negative prompt, and reusing a seed for controlled comparisons.

best_practices: Use one primary action per clip and describe camera movement early in the prompt.
Keep audio files within the documented duration, size, and format limits before using lip sync.
Confirm the output directory and remote service before running RunComfy CLI commands.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated actions in one short clip.
Do not use vague negative prompts such as requests for better quality without specific defects.
Do not submit confidential prompts, private media URLs, or tokens in shared chats.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and runs requests through the RunComfy CLI against RunComfy hosted Model API.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: You need a RunComfy account login or a RunComfy token configured for the CLI environment.

faq.question: Can I use my own audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents audio URL input for lip-sync generation with WAV or MP3 files within the stated limits.

faq.question: What output limits should I expect?
faq.answer: The documented guidance supports short clips up to 15 seconds, 720p or 1080p resolution, and five aspect ratios.

faq.question: Can I disable prompt expansion?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains when to disable prompt expansion for literal or brand-strict prompts.

faq.question: Is sensitive media safe to send?
faq.answer: Treat RunComfy as a third-party processor. Do not send confidential prompts, audio, or private media URLs unless approved.
